_readme: Registry of the sources cited by data/advice.json (ids are referenced there). Found by web search on 2026-10-04; only titles and extracts were read, so every entry starts with verified=false. Set verified=true after reading the document and checking that it supports the advice that cites it. Prefer national authorities (type 'national') over reviews and secondary sites.

UCDA_MANUALS.title: Uganda Coffee Development Authority: manuals
UCDA_MANUALS.note: Download the ARABICA handbook from here. Only the Robusta handbook was found in the search results, and Mount Elgon is arabica.

UCDA_PUBLICATIONS.title: Uganda Coffee Development Authority: publications
UCDA_PUBLICATIONS.note: Lists a regional agriculture handbook; check whether it covers leaf rust and phoma and the recommended copper fungicides.

NACORI_EXTENSION.title: NaCORI / NARO or the district extension officer (no document yet)
NACORI_EXTENSION.note: To contact for validation of the final advice, especially fungicide products and timing for Mount Elgon.

PLANTWISE_KB_CLR.title: Coffee leaf rust: Hemileia vastatrix (Plantwise Knowledge Bank datasheet)
PLANTWISE_KB_CLR.note: Closest to an official factsheet for leaf rust: symptoms and control options.

PLANTWISE_BLOG_CLR.title: Coffee leaf rust: Spotting and managing Hemileia vastatrix
PLANTWISE_BLOG_CLR.note: Short, farmer-oriented description of symptoms and management.

MDPI_CLR_KENYA.title: Coffee Leaf Rust (Hemileia vastatrix) in Kenya: A Review
MDPI_CLR_KENYA.note: Pruning, spacing, shade, fungicides, resistant varieties. East African context.

RG_CLR_UGANDA_FARMERS.title: Farmer awareness, coping mechanisms and economic implications of coffee leaf rust disease in Uganda
RG_CLR_UGANDA_FARMERS.note: What Mount Elgon farmers actually do (weeding, Bordeaux mixture, sanitation). Describes practice, not a recommendation.

EPPO_PHOMA.title: Phoma costaricensis (PHOMCO), EPPO Global Database
EPPO_PHOMA.note: Identification of the pathogen and its hosts.

CULTIVAR_PHOMA.title: Phoma spot or ascochyta spot of coffee
CULTIVAR_PHOMA.note: Brazilian trade magazine: cultural control, windbreaks, balanced fertilisation, preventive copper. Find a primary source before relying on it.

ROASTOPEDIA_PHOMA.title: Phoma Leaf Spot (Phoma costarricensis)
ROASTOPEDIA_PHOMA.note: Summary page; use only to find primary sources.

RG_FARMERS_KNOWLEDGE_UGANDA.title: Farmers' Knowledge of Pests and Diseases in the Coffee-Banana Agroforestry Systems of Mid-Eastern Uganda
RG_FARMERS_KNOWLEDGE_UGANDA.note: Local context on how farmers recognise and name coffee diseases.
